description: A frozen-policy short-horizon search on four Training-only seeds found no safe improvement for the 60 N positive-y impact, but found one negative-y intervention that improved terminal recovery-target progress on both independent 49 N cases while reducing disallowed self-contact steps from two to zero. Distill its 24 pre-transform actor targets into the same state-conditioned Policy while preserving the complete no-reset Mission progression, Program prior, lateral-only authority, bilateral consistency regularizer, seed, budget, and locked Judge.
